limitations: Bounded Linux offscreen runs, not the user computer or sustained 24-hour throughput; user 4.5 factor was not reproduced.
GUI auto-render cadence adapts naturally; both versions use identical settings and viewport. These speeds are model seconds / wall seconds, not FPS.
Three main cases have two trials per variant; the additional hinge-motion case has one.
The post-deployment 14x4 sample covers drones in flight and excavators waiting for transport.
Counters exclude loading and report generation. Zero support_ground_checks means no repeated full bearing checks on unchanged local ground; local snapshots and obstacle checks remain active.
Windows and CI for the new local commit were not run; no push was performed.
